_readme: Photography library. Three source types: 'unsplash' (Unsplash photo ID), 'commons' (Wikimedia Commons thumb path, needs a credit) or 'src' (your own file in src/assets/img/, e.g. "/assets/img/ngong-race-day.jpg"). All current images are illustrative - none show syndicate horses. Replace them with your own Kenyan race-day photography as soon as you have it.
